none: PAS SUSS-3A4982: Roman coin: Denarius of Septimius Severus
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver plated contemporary copy of a Roman denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211 AD). Minted in Rome, c. 194-196 AD. Reece Period 10. The reverse shows Minerva standing left with downward-pointing transverse spear and round shield; legend: PM[TRPIII] COSII [PP].
